mapper.select: SELECT mm.memo_no AS memoNo, mm.member_no AS memberNo, mm.content AS content, mm.created_at AS createdAt, m.member_id AS memberId, m.name AS memberName FROM member_memo mm JOIN member m ON mm.member_no = m.member_no ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
SELECT mm.memo_no AS memoNo, mm.member_no AS memberNo, mm.content AS content, mm.created_at AS createdAt FROM member_memo mm WHERE mm.member_no = #{memberNo} ORDER BY mm.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_memo (memo_no, member_no, content, created_at) VALUES (seq_memo.nextval, #{memberNo}, #{content}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE member_memo SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE memo_no = #{memoNo}
